name: SparrowCRM
tagline: AI CRM from the SurveySparrow team with deal pipelines, email sequences, AI agents and the Ask Zulie assistant.
bestFor: Small sales teams that want a free AI CRM and can grow into per-seat plans
description: SparrowCRM is a sales CRM from SurveySparrow, launched in September 2026. It covers contacts, companies and deals with Kanban views, email sync and sequences, workflows, and AI agents that update records and summarize calls and emails. A free plan covers 3 seats; paid plans start at $19 per seat per month billed annually ($24 billed monthly) for Growth.
pros: Free plan for up to 3 seats and 50,000 records, with the Ask Zulie AI assistant and deal Kanban views
Sequence analytics show open, click and reply rates per step
Workflows, email sequences and unlimited seats from Growth ($19/seat/month billed annually)
Custom AI agents can be built by describing a task in plain language
cons: Calling runs through connected apps (RingCentral or Aircall); no native dialer is documented
Mobile app access is listed only on Enterprise
Public API, custom objects and lead routing require Pro ($49/seat/month billed annually)
freePlanDetails: Free forever for up to 3 seats and 50,000 records; includes Ask Zulie, email sync, deal Kanban views, reports and 100 AI credits per user per month. No credit card required.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 3 seats, 50,000 records; Ask Zulie AI copilot; enrichment; email auto sync; calling and call recording via connected apps; deal Kanban views; custom reports and dashboards; 100 AI credits per user/month.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Unlimited seats and records; meeting recording and transcription; email sequences; workflows; audit log; all app integrations; custom roles; chat and email support; 600 AI credits per user/month.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Meeting and deal intelligence; AI scores; custom objects; lead routing; email sequence analytics; public API; 2 active AI agents per user; 2,000 AI credits per user/month.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote only. Unlimited AI agents; SSO/SAML; MCP; goals and forecasting; mobile app access; priority support; 4,000 AI credits per user/month.

integrations: App integrations on Growth and above, including Zoom, RingCentral and Aircall; public API on Pro; MCP on Enterprise
support: Chat and email support (Growth and above)

sources.label: SparrowCRM help center: managing sequences and tracking results
SparrowCRM help center: set up calling

launch.what: SurveySparrow launched SparrowCRM worldwide as its third product, with a free plan and a 14-day trial.

name: Twenty
tagline: Open-source CRM with custom objects, Kanban views, workflows and AI agents, available as cloud or self-hosted.
bestFor: Technical teams that want an open-source CRM they can self-host or customize
description: Twenty is an open-source CRM (AGPL v3) with people, companies and opportunities, unlimited custom objects, table, Kanban and calendar views, workflows and AI agents. Version 2.0 shipped in April 2026. Self-hosting is free; Cloud Pro costs $9 per user per month billed yearly ($12 billed monthly).
pros: Open-source core can be self-hosted for free
Unlimited custom objects, fields, views and records on every plan
Workflows, AI agents, REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and an MCP server on every cloud plan
Low entry price: $9/user/month billed yearly
cons: Custom roles, SSO and audit logs require Organization ($39/user/month billed yearly)
No built-in dialer or email open tracking is listed on the pricing page
freePlanDetails: Self-hosting the open-source core is free, with AI running on your own provider keys and community support. There is no free cloud plan.

plans.name: Self-hosted
plans.notes: Open-source core under AGPL v3; all Pro CRM features plus custom roles; bring your own AI provider keys; community support on Discord.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Cloud. About 100 personal AI tasks per member per week; 1 workspace credit per user per month (about 10,000 workflow steps); Admin and Member roles; email and chat support; 50 API calls/min.

plans.name: Organization
plans.notes: Cloud. About 500 personal AI tasks per member per week; 4 workspace credits per user per month; custom roles down to fields and rows; SAML/OIDC SSO; audit logs; custom domain; priority support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: From $50k per year. SCIM, single-tenant isolation, IP allow-listing, dedicated support with SLA.

integrations: Google and Microsoft email and calendar sync; Slack; People Data Labs; app marketplace; REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and MCP server (works with Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor)

sources.label: Twenty pricing page (monthly and yearly toggle)
heise: Twenty 2.0, the open-source CRM follows up

launch.what: Twenty released version 2.0.0, adding MCP and OAuth access for AI clients, a redesigned interface and new self-hosting and billing infrastructure.

name: Day AI
tagline: AI-native CRM that builds customer records from email, calendar, meetings and Slack, priced per AI agent.
bestFor: B2B revenue teams that want AI agents to keep the pipeline current, alone or on top of Salesforce or HubSpot
description: Day AI builds a customer record from email, calendar, meetings and Slack, and runs AI agents that prep meetings, draft follow-ups and update the pipeline. It can replace Salesforce or HubSpot or draft updates back to them. Pricing is per agent, where each agent is assigned to one person; pipeline management starts at Professional, $60 per agent per month billed annually ($75 billed monthly).
pros: Free seats for teammates who only need their meetings and emails captured
Pipeline board and table views, custom properties and pipeline analytics on Professional
Can run as the CRM or on top of Salesforce or HubSpot, drafting updates for review
Volume discounts apply automatically on annual billing (Professional drops to $30 at 301+ agents)
cons: Every workspace needs at least one Professional or Executive agent ($60 or $200/month billed annually)
No built-in dialer or email open tracking is described
No dedicated mobile app; mobile access goes through the Claude mobile app
freePlanDetails: Free for teammates who capture meetings, emails and interactions; they can search, view and share records. A workspace needs at least one paid Professional or Executive agent.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Gmail and calendar ingestion, meeting recording, search and read customer memory, create and update people and organizations. No automated skills.

plans.name: Turbo
plans.notes: Per agent. Tasks, email drafts, web search, pages, lists; 2 automated skill slots. Annual price falls to $12 at 301+ agents.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Per agent. Pipeline and opportunity management, pipeline analytics, campaign sequences, custom views and properties; 5 automated skill slots. Annual price falls to $30 at 301+ agents.

plans.name: Executive
plans.notes: Per agent. Campaigns from lists or customer memory, custom campaign instructions, contact identification; 10 automated skill slots. Annual price falls to $117 at volume.

plans.name: Super
plans.notes: Per agent, annual plans only. Agentic web prospecting, lookalike prospecting, end-to-end campaign setup.

integrations: Gmail and Google Calendar, Slack, Zoom, Gong, Snowflake, Amplitude, Asana, Zapier; Salesforce and HubSpot write-back; API, SDK and MCP

sources.label: Day AI pricing page (monthly and annual toggle)

name: Lightfield
tagline: AI-native CRM that updates records from email, meetings and Slack, with a call recorder, sequences and enrichment built in.
bestFor: Founder-led and small sales teams that want the CRM to fill itself in from calls and email
description: Lightfield is an AI-native CRM from the founders of Tome. It syncs email, calendar and Slack, records and transcribes meetings, and updates accounts, contacts and opportunities on its own. Starter costs $89 per user per month billed monthly for up to 3 seats; larger plans are priced per workspace and billed annually, from $999 per month.
pros: Records update automatically from email and meeting content
Meeting recording and transcription included from Starter
Opportunity boards grouped by stage, with automatic stage changes that can be corrected in one click
SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA and GDPR listed on the pricing page
cons: Starter is limited to 3 seats; the next plan is $999/month per workspace billed annually
Workflows, sequences and dashboards start at Pro
Voice dialer is listed as coming soon; no built-in calling yet

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Per user, billed monthly; no annual price published. Up to 3 seats and 50,000 records; automatic record updates; meeting recording; email, calendar and Slack sync; custom objects and pipelines; email support.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $999/month per workspace, billed annually (not a per-user price). 5 capture seats, unlimited viewer seats, 250,000 records; workflows, multi-channel sequences, dashboards, workspace credits; dedicated CSM. Extra capture seats $200/month billed annually.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: $2,999/month per workspace, billed annually (not a per-user price). 10 capture seats, 750,000 records; inbox warming, advanced enrichment, Lightfield Assistant; voice dialer coming soon.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote only, billed annually. Object and record permissions, SSO, SCIM, enforced MFA, bi-directional CRM sync, custom integrations.

integrations: Google and Outlook email and calendar, Slack, LinkedIn; API, MCP and CLI; two-way sync with Salesforce or HubSpot on Enterprise

sources.label: Lightfield docs: pipelines (boards grouped by stage)
Lightfield blog: Why we built Lightfield

launch.what: Tome's founders launched Lightfield publicly as an AI-native CRM; a $47M Series A followed in September 2026.

name: Reevo
tagline: AI sales platform that combines CRM, dialer, sequences, enrichment and call recording in one product.
bestFor: Sales teams that want to replace a separate CRM, dialer, sequencer and data provider with one platform
description: Reevo combines a CRM with prospecting data, email sequences, a built-in dialer, meeting recording and the Ask Reevo AI assistant. Opportunities have Kanban views, multiple pipelines and forecasting. Pricing is not published; all plans are quoted by sales.
pros: Built-in dialer with 1,000 minutes per user per month on Core and an iOS app for calls
Kanban opportunity views, multiple pipelines and forecasting
Email open rates reported for outreach
SOC 2 and ISO 27001 listed
cons: No prices are published; every plan requires talking to sales
Workflow automation is metered by workflow credits per org per month
No free plan or self-serve trial is listed

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Quote only. 1,000 enrichment credits, 1,000 dialer minutes and 2,500 meeting minutes per user/month; 50 active sequences; 20,000 workflow credits per org/month; 48-hour support SLA.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Quote only. 2,000 enrichment credits, 2,000 dialer minutes and 4,000 meeting minutes per user/month; 100 active sequences; 40,000 workflow credits per org/month; 24-hour SLA; Slack Connect with the Reevo team.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote only. Plan built with the customer.

integrations: Integrations page and MCP; webhook forms from HubSpot, Typeform, Webflow and others; Clay webhooks; public API
support: Support SLA of 48 hours (Core) or 24 hours (Pro)
